struggle--noun.def: A hard effort against a difficulty.
struggle--noun.ex: It was a struggle to stay awake.

channel--noun.def: A television station, or a narrow passage for water.
channel--noun.ex: The news is on another channel.

basement--noun.def: The floor of a building below the ground.
basement--noun.ex: The boxes are in the basement.

bound--adj.def: Certain to happen, or required by duty.
bound--adj.ex: He is bound to notice the change.

guide--noun.def: A person who shows the way, or a book of advice.

guide--verb.def: To show someone the way or how to do something.
guide--verb.ex: She guided us through the old city.

transfer--verb.def: To move someone or something to another place.

punishment--noun.def: Something unpleasant done to someone for a fault.

flash--adj.def: Happening very suddenly and for a short time.
flash--adj.ex: A flash flood closed the road.

bowl--verb.def: To throw the ball at the batsman in cricket.

supply--noun.def: An amount of something that is available.
supply--noun.ex: The water supply was cut off.

hopefully--adv.def: Used to say what you hope will happen.

rolling--adj.def: Turning over and over, or gently rising and falling.

demand--noun.def: A strong request, or the need customers have.
demand--noun.ex: There is high demand for nurses.

demand--verb.def: To ask for something very firmly.

particularly--adv.def: More than usual, or above all.

joint--adj.def: Shared by two or more people.

package--noun.def: Something wrapped for sending, or a set of things together.

possibility--noun.def: The chance that something may happen.
possibility--noun.ex: There is a possibility of snow.

civil--adj.def: Relating to citizens rather than the army or religion.
civil--adj.ex: The country avoided a civil war.

express--verb.def: To say or show what you think or feel.

trail--noun.def: A rough path, or a line of marks left behind.
trail--noun.ex: The trail leads to a waterfall.

option--noun.def: One of the things you can choose.

recall--verb.def: To remember something, or to ask for goods back.

accent--noun.def: The way someone pronounces a language.
accent--noun.ex: She speaks with a Scottish accent.

embarrassed--adj.def: Feeling uncomfortable in front of other people.
embarrassed--adj.ex: He was embarrassed by the applause.

charity--noun.def: An organization that helps people in need.
charity--noun.exTr: Hayır kurumu her gün yüzlerce kişiyi doyuruyor.

balance--noun.def: A steady state, or the money left in an account.
balance--noun.ex: She lost her balance on the ice.

nuclear--adj.def: Relating to the energy inside atoms.
nuclear--adj.ex: The country has no nuclear weapons.

impression--noun.def: The idea or feeling you get about something.

network--noun.def: A system of connected people, roads or computers.

defeat--verb.def: To beat someone in a game or a war.

ceremony--noun.def: A formal event held for an important occasion.

league--noun.def: A group of teams that play against each other.
league--noun.ex: Our club plays in the second league.

plastic--noun.def: A light artificial material used for many objects.
plastic--noun.ex: The toy is made of plastic.

crisis--noun.def: A time of great danger or difficulty.
crisis--noun.ex: The country faced an economic crisis.

fifth--noun.ex: A fifth of the class was absent.

term--noun.def: A period of study, or a word with a special meaning.
term--noun.ex: The spring term begins in February.

aboard--adv.def: On or onto a ship, a plane or a train.

sweat--noun.def: The liquid that comes from your skin when you are hot.
sweat--noun.ex: His shirt was wet with sweat.

bust--verb.def: To break something, or for police to raid a place.

afterwards--adv.def: After the event you are talking about.

comfort--noun.def: A pleasant easy state, or relief from sadness.
comfort--noun.ex: The old chair offers little comfort.

gym--noun.def: A room or building with equipment for exercise.
gym--noun.ex: He goes to the gym twice weekly.
gym--noun.exTr: Haftada iki kez spor salonuna gidiyor.

crush--noun.def: A short strong feeling of love for someone.
crush--noun.ex: She had a crush on her neighbour.

stress--noun.def: Worry caused by a difficult situation.
stress--noun.ex: Exams cause a lot of stress.

cave--noun.def: A large hole in the side of a hill or under ground.
cave--noun.ex: The cave is open to visitors.

wing--noun.def: The part a bird or a plane uses to fly.
wing--noun.ex: The bird hurt its left wing.

arrange--verb.def: To plan an event, or to put things in order.
arrange--verb.ex: She arranged a meeting for Friday.

launch--verb.def: To start something new, or to send a rocket into space.
launch--verb.ex: They launched the app last month.

tax--noun.def: Money that people must pay to the government.

insist--verb.def: To say something firmly and refuse to change.
insist--verb.ex: He insisted on paying the bill.

selfish--adj.ex: That was a selfish thing to do.

bat--verb.def: To hit the ball in cricket or baseball.

print--noun.def: Letters on paper, or a mark left by pressing.
print--noun.ex: The print is too small to read.

experiment--noun.def: A scientific test done to learn something.

attend--verb.def: To go to an event, a school or a meeting.
attend--verb.ex: Two hundred people attended the talk.

steel--noun.def: A strong metal made from iron and carbon.
steel--noun.ex: The frame is made of steel.

cabin--noun.def: A small wooden house, or a room on a ship.
cabin--noun.ex: We stayed in a mountain cabin.

financial--adj.def: Relating to money and its management.
financial--adj.ex: The firm is in financial trouble.

industry--noun.def: The making of goods, or one area of business.

bond--noun.def: A close connection between people, or a kind of investment.
bond--noun.ex: There is a strong bond between them.

painful--adj.def: Causing pain in the body or the mind.

religion--noun.def: Belief in a god, and the practices that go with it.

fuel--noun.def: Material such as petrol or wood that is burnt for power.

virus--noun.def: A tiny living thing that causes illness, or harmful software.

plain--adj.def: Simple and without decoration, or easy to understand.
plain--adj.ex: He wore a plain white shirt.

sacred--adj.def: Holy, and treated with great respect.
sacred--adj.ex: The mountain is sacred to them.

robot--noun.def: A machine that can do work by itself.

confirm--verb.def: To show that something is definitely true.

mile--noun.def: A unit of distance equal to about 1.6 kilometres.
mile--noun.ex: The beach is a mile away.

scratch--noun.def: A thin mark or cut made by something sharp.
scratch--noun.ex: There is a scratch on the screen.

valuable--adj.def: Worth a lot of money, or very useful.

distant--adj.def: Far away in space, time or relationship.
